title: Script Gap: Evaluating LLM Triage on Indian Languages in Native vs Roman Scripts in a Real World Setting

bias_targets.methodology: Benchmarking LLM triage classification performance (F1 scores) on real-world healthcare messages, comparing outcomes across native Indian scripts versus romanized (code-mixed or transliterated) text. The evaluation also includes analyzing token-level entropy, cross-model agreement, and model-generated rationales to quantify the performance degradation on romanized inputs.
